machine.description: Low-pressure 13.56 MHz RF plasma treatment chamber for micro-cleaning organic contaminants and activating metal bond pads (Au, Cu, Al) on die-attached leadframes prior to wire bonding.
machine.manufacturingProcess: Magazines of leadframes are loaded into an automated vacuum chamber. A dry mechanical pump evicts air down to < 10 Pa. Pure argon and oxygen gases are energized by a 13.56 MHz RF match network into a glow-discharge plasma, stripping organic monolayers and increasing copper surface energy to > 72 dyn/cm.
subsystems: 13.56 MHz RF Generator & Solid-State Auto-Match Network
Stainless Steel Vacuum Process Chamber with Fluoroelastomer Seals
Dry Roots Vacuum Pump & Roughing Valve Manifold
High-Precision Gas Mass Flow Controllers (MFCs for Ar, O2, H2)
Optical Emission Spectroscopy (OES) Plasma Density Endpoint Sensor

components.name: RF Auto-Match Network
components.function: Matches generator 50Ω impedance to dynamic plasma chamber impedance.
components.importantParameters: Reflected power (W), forward power (W), tune/load capacitor pos (%).
components.degradationIndicators: Reflected power surge (>30W), tuning hunt time (>5s).

components.name: Dry Vacuum Pump Stack
components.function: Evacuates chamber down to operating base pressure (10-100 Pa).
components.importantParameters: Chamber base pressure (Pa), pump vibration (mm/s), pump temp (°C).
components.degradationIndicators: Pump vibration rise (>0.4 mm/s), base pressure degradation.

components.name: Process Gas MFCs
components.function: Regulates precise mass flow of ultra-pure Argon (Ar) and Oxygen (O2).
components.degradationIndicators: MFC flow hunt, solenoid response drift.

components.name: Chamber Door Fluoroelastomer Seal
components.function: Maintains hermetic vacuum seal during high-frequency plasma cycle.
components.importantParameters: Chamber leak-up rate (Pa/min), door clamp pressure.
components.degradationIndicators: Leak rate > 2 Pa/min, visual elastomer cracking.

sensors.name: Vacuum Pump Vibration
sensors.purpose: Monitors dry vacuum pump rotor bearing condition.

sensors.name: Chamber Pressure
sensors.purpose: Measures vacuum chamber process pressure during plasma glow.

sensors.name: RF Reflected Power
sensors.purpose: Measures reflected electromagnetic power from plasma impedance mismatch.

warning.description: Chamber vacuum micro-leak or MFC drift

maintenance.maintenanceAction: Impedance match capacitor tuning & contact deoxidation
maintenance.procedureSummary: Inspect variable capacitor stepper motor, verify 50Ω load balance with dummy RF load.

maintenance.maintenanceAction: O-ring replacement and vacuum grease application
maintenance.procedureSummary: Remove chamber door O-ring, inspect groove for particulates, apply high-vacuum Krytox grease.

degradationIndicators.physicalPhenomenon: Auto-match vacuum variable capacitor dielectric wear
degradationIndicators.degradationSignificance: Reduces surface activation energy below 50 dyn/cm, leading to bond lift-off
Pump motor seizure risk during high-vacuum pump-down

symptoms.symptom: Low Surface Energy (< 52 dyn/cm on Copper)
possibleCauses: RF match network out of tune
symptoms.recommendedAction: Tune RF matching network and measure contact angle with goniometer.

failureScenarios.symptom: RF Auto-Match Capacitor Drift & Vacuum O-Ring Degradation
failureScenarios.recommendedAction: Re-tune RF matching network capacitor and replace fluoroelastomer chamber seal.
verificationSteps: Execute helium leak detector test (< 1x10^-8 mbar*L/s)
Run water droplet contact angle test (< 15 degrees)
